summary.text: Mary Georges is a Democratic state representative from Hillsborough 23 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia, which lists her as Mary Ngwanda Georges, describes her as a minister who founded the nonprofit Victory Women of Vision.

paragraphs.text: Mary Ngwanda Georges earned a bachelor's degree in human services and a master's degree in organizational management and leadership, according to Ballotpedia.
Georges won the general election for New Hampshire House of Representatives Hillsborough 23 on November 5, 2024.
